source: Scryfall Oracle subset for fixed keyword entry-counter tests

cards.name: Fading Entry Fixture
cards.oracle_text: Fading 5 (This creature enters with five fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can't, sacrifice it.)

cards.name: Graft Entry Fixture
cards.oracle_text: Graft 2 (This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it. Whenever another creature enters, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this creature onto it.)

cards.name: Vanishing Entry Fixture
cards.oracle_text: Vanishing 3 (This enchantment enters with three time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)

cards.name: Bare Vanishing Fixture
cards.oracle_text: Vanishing (At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from this enchantment. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)
